hero.title: For now, explore everything on the Free plan

metrics.timeCopy: Ship faster with starter templates and sample pipelines from day one.

betaNotice.title: Paid plans are on hold while we finish testing
betaNotice.copy: We're temporarily disabling every upgrade path while we stabilise the platform. Only the Free plan is available during the test period.
betaNotice.note: We'll notify you in the dashboard and by email the moment paid plans return.

points.one: Use the Free plan to try every core workflow without limits.
points.two: Share your feedback so we can shape the final plan structure together.
points.three: When billing resumes you'll be able to switch plans from the dashboard in one click.

free.title: Free Plan

pro.title: Pro Plan

enterprise.title: Enterprise
enterprise.subtitle: Built for teams who need custom guardrails

postPlans.headline: Help us shape the roadmap while we stay in beta
postPlans.copy: Use the Free plan to validate your scenarios and tell us what you need. We'll roll out Pro and Enterprise options gradually once the beta wraps up.

metrics.label: Suggested path
metrics.step1: Free → Test workloads for free and collect team feedback
metrics.step2: Pro (planned) → Unlock detailed monitoring once the launch goes live
metrics.step3: Enterprise (planned) → Finalise custom SLAs and dedicated regions after beta
